title: Alfredo, Alfredo
writer: Leonardo Benvenuti, Piero De Bernardi, Tullio Pinelli
actors: Dustin Hoffman, Stefania Sandrelli, Carla Gravina
plot: Alfredo, a timid young Italian, lusts after and woos the beautiful Maria Rosa. But when he manages to marry her, he discovers life is not nearly so blissful as he expected.
